question: After one truth-free-authorized fixed action, does the fresh family meet the preregistered wrong-Top-1 recovery tier or the weaker margin-sharpening tier?

evaluation.wrong_top1_recovery_gate: If at least one initial view has wrong Top-1 while target Recall@3 is 2/2, require action target Top-1, action IoU at least 0.5 and positive action margin.
evaluation.margin_sharpening_gate: If both initial views are target Top-1, require action target Top-1, action margin greater than the maximum initial margin, and action target IoU greater than the latest initial target IoU.
evaluation.tier_order: Wrong-Top-1 recovery is the stronger tier and takes precedence. Absence of an initial wrong Top-1 makes that tier NOT_EVALUABLE rather than failed.

next_action.wrong_recovery_met: Retain the truth-free active-view policy as a fresh same-provider component and expand to a second source family without tuning.
next_action.margin_sharpening_met: Retain the active trigger/action as a fresh same-provider ambiguity-reduction component. Wrong-instance recovery remains not evaluable; begin a small physical-door instance head on separate same-door positives and same-scene same-class hard negatives rather than mining more favorable scorer families.
next_action.not_met: Freeze the active-view policy as not confirmed on this family and begin the physical-door instance-head branch without changing the action or trigger.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the trigger, action, scorer, IoU threshold or tiered gates after opening action RGB
call margin sharpening wrong-instance recovery when no initial wrong Top-1 exists
associate per-view proposals as the same physical hypothesis without an explicit cross-view association mechanism
claim provider transfer, deployment, portal ownership, access, arrival or handoff
claim_boundary: A positive result can establish only fresh same-provider Development confirmation of one truth-free trigger and fixed local action at its exact tier. It cannot establish physical cross-view candidate association, provider transfer, a learned or deployable selector, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
